description: CR 118.3 a payer with no {E} is not asked how much to pay
note: Pia Nalaar connects alone and is no artifact, so alice gains no {E} and her end-step "pay one or more {E}" has no payable amount: one outcome, so nothing to ask. Any ChoosePaidEnergy prompt would fail the run, which is the assertion this case exists for; the board alone cannot tell paying zero from being spared the question, since both leave no Aetherjet.
